# Runbook — Operation name

**Owner:** Unassigned  
**Last verified:** Not yet verified  
**Applies to:** Environment/service

## Preconditions and access

List required role, approvals, credentials and safety checks.

## Procedure

Provide numbered, reversible steps. Never include real secrets.

## Verification

Define observable success and data-integrity checks.

## Rollback or recovery

Define stop conditions, rollback actions and escalation ownership.

## Evidence

Link dated logs, screenshots or reports with sensitive content removed.
